main.description: An owner ends the vote. The result is counted once, here, and stored; a secret poll's board is sealed and its issuer key destroyed, so no token can be signed or spent afterwards. Closing a closed poll answers with the same result.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such poll, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not an owner of the context.
